part: Speedrun front splitter set (End A): body post mount, front splitter and splitter holder plate, speedrun parts designed in this project. The body post mount follows the original mount of the T410R (photos and measurements of the owner), the splitter replaces the front foam bumper (the car runs without the bumper), the holder plate on top of the splitter follows the carbon plate on top of the original foam bumper (photo of the owner).
coordinate_system: Chassis plate coordinates (assembly): x across the car (+x right side seen toward End A), y along the car (End B at y = 0, End A front), z = 0 bottom face of the chassis plate. Both parts are symmetric to x = 0; the outline points are given for the right half.
design: Body post mount: plastic part on the holes H34, H35 and H36 at the front end of the chassis plate. The rear part (deck) lies on the top face of the chassis plate; its bottom has a pocket in the form of the front end of the plate (the overhang around the plate holds the part against turning). In front of the plate the part is cranked down by the thickness of the plate, so that its bottom face is flush with the bottom face of the plate; a ramp on the top face follows the front contour of the plate. Fixing to the chassis plate: 3 countersunk screws M3x6 from below through H34, H35 and H36 (owner); H36 without a boss. Bosses on H34 and H35: a base that carries the splitter and a pin that passes through the splitter; from above a screw M3x6 through the holder plate into the same boss (owner: M3x6 or M3x8). The height of the bosses follows from the 2 screws (stack_screws). Ears with raised bosses (support of the splitter) and a hexagon recess: press fit of the body posts, each held by a countersunk screw M3x6 from below. Stack: mount, splitter (on the bases of the bosses and on the ears, hexagon holes over the body posts), holder plate (carbon, on the splitter, round holes around the body posts).

source_codes.plate: Hole pattern and outline of the speedrun chassis plate (chassis_plate_speedrun_wide_motor10_geometry.json)
source_codes.photo: Estimate from the photos of the owner (top view on a ruler, scaled to the distance H34-H35 of the chassis plate)
source_codes.owner: Measurement or information of the owner (measurement sheet front_splitter_measurement_sheet.pdf)
source_codes.assumption: Not measured, assumed for the model
source_codes.design: Design value of the own part

mount_holes.note: Holes of the chassis plate under the mount: H34/H35 (x = +-16.677, y = 317.982) under the bosses of the splitter screws, H36 (x = -0.114, y = 321.224) without a boss. The mount is screwed to the chassis plate with countersunk screws M3x6 from below through all 3 holes (owner).

mount_rear_y.note: Straight rear edge of the mount: 4.0 behind the centres of H34/H35 (M4). The outer pivot block at End A ends at y = 309.45.

mount_outline.note: Outline of the right half from the rear corner to the centre line at the front edge: form from the top view photo, scaled to the measurements of the owner: width over the ears 79.5 (M1), width over the side lips 47.7 (M6), rear edge 4.0 behind H34/H35 (M4), depth on the centre line 19.2 (M5). The side lips wrap around the side edges of the chassis plate (x = 21.33).

pocket_clearance.note: Gap between the pocket (overhang) of the mount and the front contour of the chassis plate, all around.

deck_t.note: Thickness of the deck on the chassis plate: total height at the rear edge 4.5 (M7) minus the depth of the pocket 2.0 (M9). Top face of the deck at z = 4.5. Tapped hole M3 (2.5) through the deck on H36.

front_t.note: Thickness of the part in front of the chassis plate (M8; bottom face flush with the bottom face of the plate, M9).

ramp_w.note: Width (top view) of the ramp on the top face from the deck down to the front part; it follows the front contour of the plate (M10, not measured).

collar.note: Bosses on H34 and H35: diameter of the pin that passes through the splitter (as the collar of the original part, M11) and diameter of the base that carries the splitter (design; 8.0 reaches the rear edge). The base reaches from the deck to the bottom face of the splitter, the pin up to 0.1 below the top face of the splitter, so that the holder plate clamps the splitter. Tapped hole M3 (2.5) through the whole boss: screw from below and screw from above.

stack_screws.note: Screws on H34/H35 (owner): countersunk screw M3x6 from below (head in the countersink of the chassis plate, tip 6.0 above its bottom face), screw M3x6 from above (head on the holder plate; owner: M3x6 or M3x8), gap between the tips, tap drill M3. Height of the bottom face of the splitter = 6.0 + 0.5 + 6.0 - holder plate - splitter = 8.5 (with M3x8 from above: 10.5).

screw_hole_d.note: Through holes for the screws M3 (M11, M16).

ear_holes.note: Position of the holes in the ears (right ear; left ear mirrored): distance 65.6 across the car (M2), 12.0 ahead of H34/H35 (M3). Positions of the body posts.

ear_boss.note: Boss of the ears: diameter (photo, scaled), height of the top of the original boss above the bottom face (M15), hexagon recess across flats (press fit of the body post, M13) and its depth in the original boss (M16): bottom of the recess at 4.41 - 2.1 = 2.31, the body post keeps this position and its screw M3x6 from below. The boss of the own part reaches up to the bottom face of the splitter (support of the splitter); the recess reaches from 2.31 to its top.

ear_csk.note: Countersink (90 degrees) on the bottom face of the ear holes for the countersunk screws M3x6 that hold the body posts (M13).

body_post.note: Body posts (stock parts, assembly only): diameter (M13), length of the hexagon section from the bottom of the recess (M13, 2.31 above the bottom face; hexagon across flats as the recess: it reaches 1.8 into the splitter), length above the top face of the splitter (assumed, B6), bore (thread M3 of the screw M3x6 from below).

splitter_t.note: Thickness of the splitter: carbon sheet 2.0 (as the top brace and the shock towers). Bottom face on the bases of the bosses on H34/H35 and on the ears (z = 8.5, from stack_screws), top face at z = 10.5: 18.5 above the ground at the ride height of 10 (setup sheet 4).

splitter_holes.note: Holes of the splitter: diameter clearance of the holes over the collars (6.3 + 0.4 = 6.7), clearance of the hexagon holes over the body posts (across flats 7.06 + 0.1).

splitter_test_print.note: Test print of the splitter for a home 3D printer (the whole splitter does not fit on the print bed, owner): the middle part over the mount, cut out with a rectangle: half width (the mount is 79.5 wide), y from the rear edge of the splitter to 7.6 ahead of the front end of the mount. Holes over the pins and hexagon holes over the body posts as the splitter, thickness as the splitter.

splitter_rear_outline.note: Rear edge of the splitter, right half: vertices (x, y, fillet radius). Straight rear edge from -32 to 32 at y = 313 (1.0 behind the rear edge of the mount, 3.5 ahead of the outer pivot block); from there it runs forward around the front corners of the tyres at full steering lock to the side edge of the tip (see the tyre check).

splitter_front_distance.note: Front end of the splitter on the centre line: 70 ahead of the axis through the centres of the holes H34/H35 (y = 317.982 + 70 = 387.982).

splitter_overhang.note: Outer form of the splitter (owner): the lower front edge of the body (body_front_edge), offset outward by this distance and moved forward until the front end lies at splitter_front_distance.

splitter_front_radii.note: Fillet radii of the outer form at the offset points of body_front_edge, from the tip (last point) to the centre line (first point). The outer form lies at most 0.7 inside the exact offset.

holder_plate.note: Splitter holder plate on top of the splitter (as the carbon plate on top of the original foam bumper, photo of the owner): thickness (carbon sheet 2.0), diameter clearance of the round holes around the body posts (above the hexagon section). Outline as the mount; holes 3.2 on H34/H35 for the screws M3 from above.

body_front_edge.note: Lower front edge of the body (ZooRacing Hellcat), right half, (x, y): on the centre line approx. 68 ahead of the front axle (y = 286.9), receding toward the corners. Not measured (B1 to B5). The outer form of the splitter follows it (owner); the front end of the splitter is set by splitter_front_distance.

tyre_check.note: Check of the clearance to the front tyres: tyre width (spec_tires.yaml, setup sheet 4: 30), droop of the wheel below the static ride height (assumption), required clearance, steering angle checked in both directions (the free angle of the knuckle is approx. 30 toward the middle and 45 toward the outside; required: 25). Tyre as a cylinder of radius wheel_r on the wheel centre plane wheel_centre_x (running_gear_parameters.json).
